how: We read the website of every Charlotte wedding photographer listed on Lazo (131 listings, 97 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: family and studio portrait photographers who list weddings as one of many services, a Charleston studio and a multi-state booking network with Charlotte pages, and one site that had been taken over by spam. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Can I see a full gallery from a summer wedding here, including the sweaty 4 PM ceremony and the dark reception, not just the golden-hour portraits?
What is the delivery timeline for previews and the full gallery, and is a second shooter included or an add-on?
If we are marrying at a venue 45 minutes outside Charlotte, is travel included, and have you shot there before?

picks.name: Robert Burns II Photography & Videography, LLC
picks.blurb: Robert Burns II has 15 years in photography and more than 200 weddings behind him, shooting photo and video from Huntersville just north of Charlotte. Collections start at $4,000 for a full eight-hour day, previews arrive within 24 hours, and he also edits BRIDE Magazine, an annual planning publication he started for his brides.

picks.name: Brandon Pickett Photography
picks.blurb: Candid, unposed documentary coverage for couples who want the day captured honestly. Brandon Pickett is a full-time Charlotte photographer with over 350 weddings, many from his earlier years shooting Washington, D.C., and he edits every photo himself and delivers galleries with unlimited downloads.

picks.name: Avonné Photography
picks.blurb: Avonné Photography in Matthews is a documentary-style wedding photographer approaching 15 years as a professional, with roots in opera, dance and photography. Charlotte and destination weddings worldwide, from a self-described world traveler and Christ follower.

picks.name: Katherine Elena Photography
picks.blurb: Katherine Elena came to weddings sideways: a high-school darkroom habit, chemistry and psychology degrees, a few years in another field, then photography full time. Based in Fort Mill, she specializes in fine-art, emotional images, and also photographs children.

picks.name: Levar Hage Photography
picks.blurb: LeVar Hage shoots weddings and elopements with an editorial feel out of Indian Trail, and the site lists wedding packages and a planning ebook. He has photographed weddings across nine states from Arizona to Florida, and started, by his own account, as a sneaker foot model on Instagram.

picks.name: Allure Wedding Photography & Video
picks.blurb: Dodie Huffman runs Allure Wedding Photography from a studio in Belmont and works North and South Carolina. Born and raised in Clover, SC, with a college education in photography and video production; the published package pairs a lead photographer with an assistant for six hours of coverage.

picks.name: Aubrey Elizabeth Photography
picks.blurb: A bright, true-to-color, romantic style for weddings, proposals and courthouse ceremonies, from a Charlotte photographer who grew up in small-town Michigan. Aubrey Elizabeth covers the Carolinas and destination weddings, and also shoots couples, families and in-home newborns.

picks.name: Candle and Quill Photography
picks.blurb: Candle and Quill is a husband-and-wife photo and video duo based out of Charlotte, named for light and for storytelling. Collections run from portrait sessions and elopements to full-day weddings, with photography and videography options in each.

picks.name: SB Photography
picks.blurb: Candice Williams photographs weddings with her partner Quinton creating content alongside, for couples who value faith, intentionality and an elevated experience. Charlotte-based and traveling worldwide, with a published investment page that frames collections around trust and curation.

picks.name: everlasting moments photography
picks.blurb: Bre Jones of Everlasting Moments is based in Shelby and serves couples throughout Charlotte, Asheville, Greenville and destinations nationwide. Timeless imagery with an editorial lean, built around the in-between moments people only recognize as meaningful years later.

picks.name: Chantelle Jordan photography
picks.blurb: Nine years of weddings and portraits from Concord, with a pre-wedding consultation built into every package and collection pricing printed on the site. Chantelle also photographs newborns and family milestones, so expect a photographer who follows couples past the wedding.

picks.name: Off The Rails Studios
picks.blurb: Tristan and Sophie of Off The Rails Studios are a husband-and-wife team shooting candid photography and wedding films for couples in Charlotte, Fort Mill and across the Carolinas. Parents of five who hike, camp and ride dirt bikes, and happy to travel.
